text:
toni: FYI eu-south control plane noisy since ~20:03UTC. apiserver 5xxs and controller-manager leader churn noticed. GPU attach latencies skyrocketed.

frank: yep, graphs show etcd commit duration spike at 20:01 and sustained nvme queue depth on masters. attach rate to rtx-pool doubled during the window.

izzy: paste of recent logs:
```
2026-03-19T20:02:58Z controller-manager[pid]: warn: attach timeout for pod gpu-job-23, retrying
2026-03-19T20:03:01Z etcd[1]: slow-apply: txn apply took 3.1s
2026-03-19T20:03:04Z apiserver[handler]: error 503 GET /api/v1/namespaces/default/pods?watch=true
```

kai: Smartctl shows elevated write_error_count on master-03 NVMe. could be degrading drive causing high tail latencies.

rachel: any config changes recently? snapshots, compaction, or CI that touches master disks?

toni: there was an adjusted snapshot defrag window last night (moved to midnight->01:00UTC). Might have overlapped with a large rollout in eu-south pushing attach traffic. bad timing.

frank: mitigation proposal: 1) temporarily pause defrag/snapshot jobs for 45m, 2) reduce controller-manager resync frequency, 3) increase leader-election lease to 45s to cut churn. Pros/cons?

izzy: agree. downside: longer lease increases time to recover on genuine master failure. But currently leader flips are adding extra writes.

kai: I'll cordon master-03 and replace NVMe if ops agree. SMART has reallocated sectors and latency percentiles are crazy. Expect leader transfers during drain.

rachel: also, can we throttle provisioner aggressive attach loops? maybe add backoff in provisioner: 200ms -> exponential up to 5s. That reduces write pressure.

toni: quick patch diff I'll apply to cm and provisioner:
```
- --controllersync-period=1m
+ --controllersync-period=8m
+ --leader-elect-lease=45s
// provisioner: backoff base=200ms -> base=500ms, max=5s
```

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-0319-117 created. on-call: @rachel. Priority: P1.

frank: rolling these changes now in eu-south controlplane pool. Will do cm pod restart one at a time.

izzy: after rolling, etcd commit p95 dropped from 2.8s -> 0.9s within 12m. attach queue for rtx-pool fell from 38 -> 7. apiserver 503s mostly cleared.

kai: master-03 replace started. swapped NVMe, running fsck, rejoined cluster. leader transfer occurred once.

rachel: moving to follow-ups: 1) schedule immediate ephemeral extra iops for etcd (test higher iops class) 2) infra ticket to evaluate hot-spare NVMe pool for masters 3) provisioner rate-limits by default to avoid busts.

toni: cost debate: reserving additional GPUs in eu-south reduces attach churn but doesn't fix master IO. lean towards investing in master storage and provisioner throttles now; GPUs reservation as last resort.

frank: filing follow-up SRE ticket: SRE-1310 (master-iops-vs-reserve-gpus) with perf data.

izzy: note for runbook: if apiserver 5xx + attach queue growth => check master nvme SMART, etcd commit p95, and defrag/snapshot schedule overlap. add checklist item.

rachel: good. closing thread once master-03 fully healthy and incident updated. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
